g_boundaries.G0: EMS plan or strategy signal request received
g_boundaries.G1: gateway authorization and bounded admission completed
g_boundaries.G4: child instruction or control result ready
g_boundaries.G7: strategy consumer or query response returned

topology.scope_and_lane_contract: loopback EMS/strategy sidecar; bounded plan queues and isolated strategy-consumer checkpoints

load_shape.warmup: server health, benchmark reset, and metrics reset before each workload
load_shape.burst: k6 constant-arrival E1/E3/E5 and S1/S5 with query/control workloads

data_distribution.payload_classes: bounded synthetic plan, signal, event, snapshot and control requests
data_distribution.hot_key_contract: fixed hot key at configured percentage

durable_fence.G2: isolated sidecar admission record only; not a production TradeCore Journal durability claim

acceptance.status_scope: isolated EMS and strategy-consumer performance platform only
